title: KING CRIMSON  ABILITIES
features: This King Crimson script lets you master time: press G to enter "Time Erase," which hides your real character safely underground while you control a ghostly, red-tinted spirit that leaves afterimages and distorts the world's colors. Pressing G again teleports you to your spirit's current position. while pressing Y triggers a "Time Leap" to instantly dash forward. Designed with high-end visual effects and a custom UI, it provides a seamless, anime-accurate experience credited to zarar (mrmysteriousz on discord)
